title: Developing a prediction model to estimate the true burden of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in hospitalised children in Western Australia.

model.rationale: The generated text closely follows the reference, accurately reproducing the study design (population-based retrospective cohort), sample sizes (321,825 hospitalisations, 37,784 tested), methodology (multivariable logistic regression, DAG-guided selection, cross-validated AUROC, calibration), and all key results (AUROC 0.87, predicted incidence 43.7/1000 child-years, under-ascertainment 30–57%). No fabricated or unsupported claims were identified; every factual statement can be traced back to the article's abstract, methods, results, or discussion. The limitations and conclusions are also faithfully reported.
